name: product-leadgen
prompt: Screen: Lead gen, with "Lead gen" highlighted in the sidebar. Page title "Lead gen" and subtitle "Finding organizations on maps and handing them to contacts". A strip of small pills: "Collected in batch 0", "Handed today 142 of 300", "Spent $6.59", "Per lead $0.007", "Auto-collect at 3:00 AM", "Auto hand-off to contacts" and a muted link "Configure". Top right: an outlined button "Hand to contacts" and an amber button "Collect". Tabs: "Leads" (active), "Summary", "Channels". A search field "Name or phone" with a filter icon. A table with columns Organization, Phone, Rating, Reviews, Stage, What we know, Found ↓, Card. Nine rows; under each organization name a muted line with category and city: "Midwest Cold Storage — Refrigerated warehouse · Columbus, OH — +1 (614) 555-0110 — 4.8 — 150 — Handed to contacts (green pill)"; "Keystone Building Supply — Building materials · Pittsburgh, PA — no phone — 4.9 — 39 — Filtered out (muted pill) with the note Already in base"; "Pacific Coast Produce — Fresh produce distributor · Fresno, CA — 4.9 — 682 — Handed to contacts"; "Northern Timber Co. — Lumber · Thunder Bay, ON — 4.7 — 196 — Filtered out, Chain store"; "Blue Ridge Beverages — Beverage bottler · Roanoke, VA — 5.0 — 255 — Handed to contacts"; plus four more similar rows. The "What we know" column reads "Source card: Google Maps" with the source underlined; the "Found" column shows "Sep 15, 2026, 3:16 AM"; the "Card" column shows a small arrow icon on handed rows. Render it as a crisp, pixel-perfect desktop web-app screenshot, flat and straight-on, with no browser chrome, no device frame, no perspective and no watermark. Product: "MagnaQore Logistic", an AI calling and sales system for North American freight companies. Dark theme: page background deep warm charcoal #141311; panels and cards #1d1b18 with hairline borders #2c2925 and 12px rounded corners; primary text warm off-white #ece8e1; secondary text muted warm grey #8f8a82; one accent, amber-gold #e9a23b, used for the active navigation marker, count badges, primary buttons, progress fills, active tabs and toggles; green #3fae7a only for positive statuses; lead ratings shown as small rounded chips reading A, B, C or D. Typography: a clean geometric sans-serif similar to Manrope, calm spacing, 13–15px interface text that is sharp, legible and spelled correctly. Left sidebar about 230px wide: a small muted label "MagnaQore" above the bold product name "Logistic AI" with a bell icon; navigation with thin line icons in this order: Dashboard (small amber count badge), Contacts, Dialer, Calls, Chats, Lead gen, Assistant, Settings, Help, System; at the bottom a user block "Alex Morgan" with the role "Sales ops" and a log-out icon. All people, companies, phone numbers and figures are fictional; phone numbers use the US 555 range. English only.
